meta.title: Per-Guest Spend Plan — the 10 moves
meta.source: YBC Per Guest Spend Brief v2 (Toast data through July 22, 2026)
meta.headline: Net sales nearly doubled Feb→Jun ($99.5K→$194.6K) while spend per guest fell 22% ($30.34→$23.56), six straight months down. Volume is not the problem, structure is.
meta.target: $150K–$250K added annual revenue and protected margin at current traffic. Food from $9.50 to $12 per guest ≈ $210K/yr alone.

moves.what: Printed bottomless mimosa or beermosa add-on, roughly $25, on the brunch menu
Staff Tuesday to demand (Wednesday levels), retest or replace salsa night
Reason codes required, manager PIN over $15, weekly report by employee
Top taps printed with prices, house beers listed first, pairing lines
Pint and a Smash $19, Wings and a Pint $20, on Wed/Thu/Sun menus
Upsell prompts on handhelds and the QR ordering flow (16% of sales)
Double from $18 to $16, single stays $13, moves volume up $3
One line at the bottom of Headliners, plus a table tent
Display by the door, QR on show cards, staff in the gear, beer to go
Assign categories, merge duplicate beer buttons, build revenue centers

watch_items: Server gap: $22.01–$29.94 per guest among 20+ shift servers (36% spread). Debrief Joe Rubbo and Chrissy Heffelfinger; print what they say into menus/bundles/prompts.
Voids: $12.6K/quarter (~$50K/yr) with no reason codes. Reads as error and workflow, not theft.
Online Ordering revenue center: $32.7K in June, ~16% of sales, unconfirmed routing (likely QR at table). Best place to install structural upsell.
External beer (Corona/Coors): 1,600+ pours at 25–30 pts worse margin. House beers listed first everywhere.
Dead categories: desserts $2,492/90d; NA $0.32/guest; merch $1,115/quarter; off-premise 4.6% of sales.
Discounts/comps are CLEAN: 2.4% of sales, normal band — marketing, not leakage.
